API latency postmortem

The p99 latency of the search endpoint reached 840 milliseconds during the incident window on tuesday morning.

Revised measurement: the p99 latency of the search endpoint was corrected to 620 milliseconds after clock skew was removed.

The incident review concluded that the search endpoint latency regression was caused by a missing composite database index.

Do not delete the user account table during the migration scheduled for this weekend under any circumstance.

Random lunch poll: votes are split between tacos and sushi for the team outing next friday afternoon.

The missing composite database index on the search endpoint was rebuilt, restoring p99 latency to the normal range.
